_README: Permission rules this pack NEEDS in order to run its own gates without an approval prompt per step.
MERGE these into the permissions.allow array of ~/.claude/settings.json. Do not replace the file:
it also holds your model, theme, plugins and env. Merge, never overwrite.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: v2.1.13 shipped this fix as a paragraph in CHANGELOG.md and nothing else.
A paragraph is not installable, so the rules never landed on the machine that needed them and every
pipeline script kept prompting. A denied prompt is a skipped gate, and a skipped gate is how a build
passes while carrying 1.4% of its reference. Anything the pack requires of its host belongs in a file
the host can apply, not in prose describing it.
PATHS: replace <SCRIPTS> with the ABSOLUTE path of this pack's scripts dir on your machine, e.g.
Keep BOTH slash directions on Windows: the Bash tool emits forward slashes, PowerShell emits
backslashes, and a permission rule matches a LITERAL prefix (webflow-core § I). One direction alone
still prompts for half the pipeline.
COMMAND SHAPE still matters after this: the rule only matches when the script is invoked as ONE
command with the absolute path and nothing before it. `cd $WF/scripts && node x.js`, a $WF variable
and a ~ path all MISS it, by design.
_DENY_README: The two denied tools are Invariant 1 (native only) enforced by the harness rather than by the agent's
own restraint. data_whtml_builder injects raw HTML; data_scripts_tool registers custom scripts. Neither
has a legitimate use in a native build, and a rule the harness enforces cannot be argued away under
context pressure. Keep them denied even when a build feels stuck — the answer is a tier descent
(build-reference § EFFECT FIDELITY LADDER), not an escape hatch.
